description.p: A small, native file browser with Miller columns: every folder from / down to where you are sits in its own column, and the selected file is previewed on the right. Like a mind map of your disk.

ul.li: Preview of pictures, video frames, music covers, PDF pages, text and archive contents
A gallery of a folder's pictures under its details, sharing the thumbnail cache with Thunar
Search through a folder and every folder below it
Trash: put back, delete permanently, empty
A Computer column with all disks, USB sticks and network shares
Checksums, sorting per folder, your own highlight colour

description.p: No service running in the background. Optional helpers (ffmpeg, pdftoppm, Blender) add more previews when they are installed.

screenshot.caption: A picture fitted into the preview
The Computer column: disks, USB sticks and network

description.p: Translations (German, Greek, and two joke languages: Wizard and Wienerisch), a man page, and gallery picks highlighted in the column.
Search, a trash window, checksums, Blender previews, thumbnail sizes, Set default program, and "Show in folder" over D-Bus.
A double-click starts programs, asks before running scripts and starts launchers.
The Computer column, settings in three tabs, thumbnails not in network folders.
